tickets.title: User deactivation
tickets.spec: Add `func (u *Users) Deactivate(id string) error` to service/users.go: load the user, set Active=false, persist it, and return ErrNotFound for a missing id. Keep model/user.go changes minimal if you need any.

tickets.title: Discounted invoicing
tickets.spec: Add `func DiscountedInvoice(subtotalCents, discountPct int) int` to service/billing.go: apply the percentage discount to the subtotal (round down), then apply tax exactly as Invoice does. Add `func (o *Orders) TotalWithDiscount(userID string, discountPct int) int` to service/orders.go returning DiscountedInvoice(TotalFor(userID), discountPct).

tickets.title: User count endpoint
tickets.spec: Add HTTP endpoint `/users/count` returning JSON {"count": N} with status 200, where N is the number of stored users (keys with prefix "user/" in the Users service's store). Wire it in Router(); implement the handler in api/handlers.go using a.Users.S via a small exported helper if needed — do not modify files outside api/.

tickets.title: Store TTL support
tickets.spec: Add `PutTTL(key string, value []byte, expiresAt int64)` to the KV interface in store/kv.go and implement it in Mem: entries stored with PutTTL are invisible to Get and Keys once util.Now() >= expiresAt. Plain Put entries never expire. Keep existing methods' signatures unchanged.

tickets.title: Order audit log
tickets.spec: Create util/audit.go with package-level `func Audit(event string)` and `func AuditLog() []string` (append-only, in order). In Orders.Create, on success call util.Audit("order.created " + order.ID).

tickets.title: Email validation
tickets.spec: Add `func ValidEmail(e string) bool` to model/user.go: must contain exactly one '@' with at least one '.' after it, and no spaces. Users.Create must return an error (any non-nil error) for invalid emails without storing anything.

tickets.title: Order count endpoint
tickets.spec: Add HTTP endpoint `/orders/count` returning JSON {"count": N} with status 200, where N is the number of stored orders (keys with prefix "order/" in the Orders service's store). Wire it in Router(); implement in api/handlers.go — do not modify files outside api/.

tickets.title: Namespaced IDs
tickets.spec: Add `func SetIDNamespace(ns string)` to util/ids.go: when set to a non-empty value, NewID returns "<ns>/<kind>-<n>" instead of "<kind>-<n>"; empty ns restores the default. Users.Create keeps using util.NewID and must work under any namespace (its storage key remains "user/"+ID).

tickets.title: Minimum charge
tickets.spec: Invoice must never return less than 50 cents: any computed amount below 50 becomes exactly 50. Preserve every other behavior of Invoice, including behaviors teammates may be adding in parallel (fees, tax rules).

tickets.title: Processing fee
tickets.spec: Invoice must add a fixed processing fee of 25 cents to the subtotal before tax is computed. Preserve every other behavior of Invoice, including behaviors teammates may be adding in parallel (minimums, tax rules).

tickets.title: Large-order tax waiver
tickets.spec: For subtotals of 100000 cents or more, Invoice must charge no tax: the result is the subtotal plus any fixed fees only. Preserve every other behavior of Invoice, including behaviors teammates may be adding in parallel (minimums, fees).

tickets.title: Request-ID header
tickets.spec: Every response served through Router() must carry an X-Request-Id header whose value is a fresh util.NewID("req"). Implement by wrapping the mux in Router(); do not modify files outside api/.

tickets.title: Request log
tickets.spec: The api package must record the URL path of every request served through Router(), in order, exposed via an exported func RequestLog() []string. Do not modify files outside api/.

tickets.title: Error envelope
tickets.spec: Error responses from handleUserGet must be JSON of the form {"error": <message>, "code": <http status>} — the numeric HTTP status repeated in the body. Success responses unchanged. Do not modify files outside api/.

tickets.title: Store Len
tickets.spec: Add `func (m *Mem) Len() int` returning the number of visible entries. Method on Mem only — do NOT change the KV interface.

tickets.title: Store Clear
tickets.spec: Add `func (m *Mem) Clear()` removing all entries. Method on Mem only — do NOT change the KV interface.

tickets.title: Store snapshot/restore
tickets.spec: Add `func (m *Mem) Snapshot() map[string][]byte` (deep copy of current entries) and `func (m *Mem) Restore(s map[string][]byte)` (replace all entries with a deep copy of s). Methods on Mem only — do NOT change the KV interface.

tickets.title: Order status
tickets.spec: Add a Status string field to model.Order (empty by default) and `func (o *Orders) SetStatus(id, status string) error` that loads the order, sets Status, persists it, and returns ErrNotFound for a missing id.

tickets.title: Clock helpers
tickets.spec: Add `func Since(t int64) int64` returning Now()-t, and `func Deadline(d int64) int64` returning Now()+d.

tickets.title: User listing
tickets.spec: Add `func (u *Users) List() ([]*model.User, error)` returning all stored users sorted by ID ascending.

tickets.title: Negative-subtotal rejection
tickets.spec: Invoice must reject negative subtotals by returning exactly 0 before applying fees, tax, minimums, waivers, or caps. Preserve every behavior for non-negative inputs, including behaviors teammates may be adding in parallel.

tickets.title: Invoice hard cap
tickets.spec: Invoice must never return more than 5000000 cents: any computed amount above that becomes exactly 5000000, applied as the final step after every other rule. Preserve every other behavior of Invoice, including behaviors teammates may be adding in parallel (minimums, fees, tax rules, negative handling).

tickets.title: Server identity header
tickets.spec: Every response served through Router() must carry the header `X-Served-By: fleetsvc`. Do not modify files outside api/.

tickets.title: Request blocklist
tickets.spec: Requests carrying the header `X-Blocked: true` must be rejected by Router() with HTTP status 403 before reaching any handler; all other requests are unaffected. Do not modify files outside api/.

tickets.title: Store Range iteration
tickets.spec: Add `func (m *Mem) Range(prefix string, fn func(key string, value []byte) bool)` to store/memstore.go: call fn once per visible entry whose key starts with prefix, in ascending key order, stopping early if fn returns false. Method on Mem only — do NOT change the KV interface.

tickets.title: Store value isolation
tickets.spec: Mem must not alias caller or internal memory: Put stores a copy of the value slice (later mutation of the caller's slice must not change stored data), and Get returns a copy (mutating the returned slice must not change stored data). Preserve all existing method signatures and behavior.

tickets.title: Email lowercasing
tickets.spec: Users.Create must lowercase the email before storing it (and before any validation or duplicate checks teammates may be adding); the returned and fetched user's Email is the lowercased input.

tickets.title: Duplicate email rejection
tickets.spec: Users.Create must return an error (any non-nil error) when a user with the same email is already stored, comparing values as stored after any normalization teammates may be adding (lowercasing, trimming); nothing is stored on rejection. Distinct emails must both succeed.

tickets.title: Email trimming
tickets.spec: Users.Create must trim leading and trailing whitespace (spaces and tabs) from the email before storing it and before any validation, duplicate check, or other normalization; the stored Email carries no surrounding whitespace.

tickets.title: Reject non-positive orders
tickets.spec: Orders.Create must return an error (any non-nil error) for cents <= 0 and store nothing; positive amounts are unaffected.

tickets.title: Order creation timestamp
tickets.spec: Add a `CreatedAt int64` field to model.Order, set by Orders.Create from util.Now() at creation time, persisted and visible through Orders.Get.

tickets.title: Defensive totals
tickets.spec: Orders.TotalFor must ignore stored orders whose Cents <= 0 (defensive against records written by paths other than Create); orders with positive Cents sum exactly as before.

tickets.title: ID validation
tickets.spec: Add `func ValidID(id, kind string) bool` to util/ids.go: true iff id ends with kind + "-" + one or more decimal digits; any prefix before that suffix (for example a namespace) is permitted. False otherwise.

tickets.title: Per-kind ID counting
tickets.spec: Add `func IDCount(kind string) int` to util/ids.go returning how many identifiers NewID has issued for that kind during the current process (0 for kinds never issued). Counting must keep working under any namespace settings teammates may add.

tickets.title: ID kind extraction
tickets.spec: Add `func KindOf(id string) string` to util/ids.go: for identifiers shaped like NewID output — optionally preceded by a namespace prefix ending in '/' — return the kind: everything after the last '/' (if any) and before the final '-'. Return "" when id does not end with '-' followed by one or more digits.

tickets.title: User display name
tickets.spec: Add `func (u *User) DisplayName() string` to model/user.go: the part of Email before the first '@'; the whole Email when it contains no '@'.

tickets.title: User clone
tickets.spec: Add `func (u *User) Clone() *User` to model/user.go returning a copy: changes to the clone's fields never affect the original and vice versa. It must copy every field the struct has at build time, including fields teammates may be adding.

tickets.title: Health endpoint
tickets.spec: Add HTTP endpoint `/health` returning status 200 with JSON body {"status": "ok"}. Wire it in Router(); do not modify files outside api/.

tickets.title: Order total endpoint
tickets.spec: Add HTTP endpoint `/orders/total` returning JSON {"total": N} with status 200, where N is Orders.TotalFor of the `user_id` query parameter. Wire it in Router(); implement in api/handlers.go; do not modify files outside api/.

tickets.title: Version endpoint
tickets.spec: Add exported `const Version = "1"` to api/handlers.go and HTTP endpoint `/version` returning JSON {"version": Version} with status 200. Wire it in Router(); do not modify files outside api/.

tickets.title: String truncation
tickets.spec: Create util/truncate.go with `func Truncate(s string, n int) string`: the first n runes of s (the whole string when it has n runes or fewer); n <= 0 returns "".

tickets.title: String reversal
tickets.spec: Create util/reverse.go with `func ReverseString(s string) string` reversing the sequence of runes.

tickets.title: Integer clamping
tickets.spec: Create util/clamp.go with `func ClampInt(v, lo, hi int) int`: lo when v < lo, hi when v > hi, otherwise v. When lo > hi, return lo.

tickets.title: Absolute value
tickets.spec: Create util/abs.go with `func AbsInt(v int) int` returning the absolute value.

tickets.title: Retry backoff
tickets.spec: Create util/backoff.go with `func Backoff(attempt int) int64`: 100 * 2^attempt milliseconds, capped at 10000; any attempt <= 0 returns 100.

tickets.title: Slug generation
tickets.spec: Create util/slug.go with `func Slug(s string) string`: lowercase the string; keep ASCII letters and digits; replace every maximal run of any other characters with a single '-'; trim leading and trailing '-'.

tickets.title: Money formatting
tickets.spec: Create model/money.go with `func FormatCents(c int) string` rendering cents as dollars: "12.34" for 1234, two-digit cents always, negative amounts with a leading '-' (FormatCents(-5) == "-0.05").

tickets.title: ZIP validation
tickets.spec: Create model/zip.go with `func ValidZip(s string) bool`: true iff s is exactly five ASCII digits.

tickets.title: Atomic counter
tickets.spec: Create store/counter.go with a `Counter` type: `func NewCounter() *Counter`, `func (c *Counter) Inc() int` (increment by one and return the new value), `func (c *Counter) Value() int`. Safe for concurrent use.

tickets.title: Prefix counting
tickets.spec: Create store/prefixcount.go with `func CountPrefix(kv KV, prefix string) int` returning the number of visible keys with the prefix (as reported by Keys).

tickets.title: String set
tickets.spec: Create util/set.go with a `StringSet` type: `func NewStringSet() *StringSet`, `Add(s string)` (duplicate adds are no-ops), `Has(s string) bool`, `Len() int`.

tickets.title: FIFO queue
tickets.spec: Create util/queue.go with a `Queue` type for strings: `func NewQueue() *Queue`, `Push(s string)`, `Pop() (string, bool)` returning items first-in-first-out; Pop on an empty queue returns ("", false).

tickets.title: LIFO stack
tickets.spec: Create util/stack.go with a `Stack` type for strings: `func NewStack() *Stack`, `Push(s string)`, `Pop() (string, bool)` returning items last-in-first-out; Pop on an empty stack returns ("", false).

tickets.title: Email domain extraction
tickets.spec: Create model/emaildomain.go with `func EmailDomain(e string) string`: the part after the last '@'; "" when e contains no '@'.

tickets.title: Min and max
tickets.spec: Create util/minmax.go with `func MinInt(a, b int) int` and `func MaxInt(a, b int) int`.

tickets.title: Sums and means
tickets.spec: Create util/sum.go with `func SumInts(xs []int) int` and `func MeanInts(xs []int) int` — the sum divided by the length using Go's native integer division (truncated toward zero); an empty slice yields 0 for both.

tickets.title: String dedupe
tickets.spec: Create util/dedupe.go with `func DedupeStrings(xs []string) []string` keeping the first occurrence of each string, in order; an empty input yields a result of length 0.

tickets.title: String chunking
tickets.spec: Create util/chunk.go with `func ChunkStrings(xs []string, n int) [][]string` splitting xs into consecutive chunks of n items, the last chunk possibly shorter; n <= 0 returns nil.

tickets.title: Percentage calculation
tickets.spec: Create util/percent.go with `func PercentOf(part, whole int) int` returning part*100/whole using Go's native integer division; whole == 0 returns 0.

tickets.title: Median
tickets.spec: Create util/median.go with `func MedianInt(xs []int) int`: sort a copy ascending (the input slice must not be modified); odd length returns the middle value, even length returns the lower of the two middle values; empty returns 0.
